name: screenshot-to-design
title: Screenshot-to-Design
description: Analyse screenshots or visual references and derive a structured design system (palette, type, spacing, components, layout patterns).
when_to_use: The client supplied screenshots, mockups, a current site or references to match or evolve.
instructions: Describe only what is visible; estimate values (colours as hex, sizes as px/rem) and label them as measured or estimated.
Output a reusable token set and component inventory; note what should not be carried over (accessibility or quality problems).
